mutations.because: Stop the selected slot's own drawn copy from reaching the look. The list still lists, the row still highlights and every network assertion stays green — the rail simply keeps drawing the brief's campaign message for whichever creative is clicked. This is the assertion that used to sit behind a 450 ms settle and flake when the clock lost; waitFor on the headline is what makes the catch load-independent.
command: the rail composes the clicked slot's own look, not the first value of each axis
